The [Technology](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/expertise/industries/technology-companies) team advised Naïve on raising a $28.5 million Series A to build autonomous company infrastructure. The round was led by Nexus, with participation from Y Combinator, Zetta, Liquid 2, and more. With the new capital, the company intends to invest in their new lab with four research areas: serverless agents, inference, brain, and agent workforce orchestration.

[Naïve](https://usenaive.ai/) is an artificial intelligence lab that is developing autonomous agents capable of setting up and running entire businesses. The company provides developers with tools to provision entire operating stacks, including identity verification, cloud storage, and governance gateways, allowing agents to function as secure, economic entities.

The Goodwin team was led by [Andrew Harper](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/h/harper-andrew), [Mira Pranav](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/p/pranav-mira), and [Daisy Ramos Garcia](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/r/ramos-garcia-daisy), and included [Justin C. Pierce](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/p/pierce-justin), [Monica Patel](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/p/patel-monica), [Ora Grinberg](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/g/grinberg-ora), and [Isabelle Greenblatt-Gunning](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/people/g/greenblatt-izzy).

For more information on the deal, please read the [announcement](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/seandorje_today-were-announcing-na%C3%AFve-has-raised-share-7491177272725450752-FOab/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAVWM4EBYQCLOa592D0p84wl90zC9KSxZlA).
